WITH per_item AS (
  SELECT
    oi.order_item_id,
    AVG(ili.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count
  FROM Order_Items AS oi
  LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
    ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  GROUP BY oi.order_item_id
)
SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_per_item_ratio,
       AVG(line_item_count) AS avg_per_item_line_item_count
FROM per_item;
